name: ET Maypearl to Mansfield Line
researcher_notes: The Energy Information Administration project workbook (August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 427) lists a completed 24 mile, 24 inch new intrastate line from Maypearl to Mansfield, Texas, owned by Energy Transfer Co, adding 400 MMcf/d, in service December 2006, cost 48 million dollars, authority State. The workbook spells the name 'ET Mayprearl to Mansfield Line'. Only one source was found, and web searches turned up no second source. No existing GEM row matches: the Old Ocean Pipeline and Texas Independence Pipeline both start at Maypearl but are 240 and 160 mile lines going south and east, not to Mansfield. Length of 24 miles is about 38.6 km, above the 25 km rule. Endpoints are given only at town level; the state is inferred as Texas from the workbook. The Texas Railroad Commission was not checked. Owner left blank on purpose: the source says Energy Transfer Co, which has no exact match in the owner list (Energy Transfer LP is only a near match), so the ownership team should pick the spelling. Route not found.
